name: Cashback SBI Card
reviewTips: April 2026 revision: 5% online capped at ₹2,000 and 1% offline capped at ₹2,000 per statement cycle. Check gaming, tolls and government were added to exclusions.

name: Amazon Pay ICICI

reward.inrPerUnitNote: Credited as Amazon Pay balance, not statement credit.

reviewTips: Expect two Amazon rules: 5% that needs amazon_prime, and a lower rate without it. Also 2% on Amazon Pay partner merchants. Exclusions matter here: ICICI's card terms (not the product page) list no cashback on fuel, rent, EMI, education, tax/government and international spends, and flights/hotels via Amazon Pay don't get the 5%/3% rate. If the proposal has no exclusions, re-run with the terms PDF as a second --source.

name: Axis Bank ACE
reviewTips: Axis updated ACE terms from 28 Aug 2026: if the PDF predates that, find the revision link on the card page. Bill payments via Google Pay should map to the gpay_bill merchant.

name: Airtel Axis Bank
reviewTips: Network not verified. The 25% Airtel cap is 'twice the base cashback earned that month', which the app can't represent; the agent should note it rather than invent a fixed cap.

name: HDFC Millennia
reviewTips: 5% on 10 named merchants (Amazon, BookMyShow, Cult.fit, Flipkart, Myntra, Sony LIV, Swiggy, Tata CLiQ, Uber, Zomato), 1% elsewhere, each with a monthly CashPoint cap. Check the PDF's date: terms changed in 2026.

name: Flipkart SBI Card
reviewTips: Network not verified. Expect Myntra, Flipkart and Cleartrip rules plus a preferred-partners rate. If the card page comes back thin, save it as PDF.

name: Tata Neu Plus HDFC

reward.inrPerUnitNote: 1 NeuCoin = ₹1, usable only on Tata Neu and Tata brands.

reviewTips: UPI has two rates: a low one on any UPI app and a higher one via your Tata Neu UPI ID (should need partner_upi_app), all capped at 500 NeuCoins/month.

name: Tata Neu Infinity HDFC

reward.inrPerUnitNote: 1 NeuCoin = ₹1, usable only on Tata Neu and Tata brands.

reviewTips: 5% on Tata brands, 1.5% elsewhere. UPI: 0.5% on any app vs 1.5% via Tata Neu UPI ID (partner_upi_app), capped at 500 NeuCoins/month. Grocery points capped at 2,000/month.

name: Kiwi RuPay (YES / AU / PNB)
issuer: Kiwi with YES Bank, AU Bank or PNB
reviewTips: Base 1.5% on UPI scan & pay through the Kiwi app (partner_upi_app). Ignore paid Neon membership rates for now; note them.

name: Axis super.money RuPay
reviewTips: Terms changed on 1 Jan 2026 (UPI rate reworked, sub-₹100 spends excluded). Make sure the proposal reflects the 2026 version, not the 2025 launch terms.

name: Swiggy BLCK HDFC
reviewTips: This PDF covers both Ornge and BLCK: make sure only BLCK rates are used (10% Swiggy, 5% online, 1% other capped ₹1,000).

name: Swiggy Ornge HDFC
reviewTips: This PDF covers both Ornge and BLCK: make sure only Ornge rates are used (5% Swiggy and online sharing one ₹1,500 cap).

name: HDFC Regalia Gold

reward.inrPerUnitNote: ₹0.50 is a typical value (flights/hotels via SmartBuy or vouchers); statement credit is worth less.

reviewTips: From 15 May 2026: 5 points per ₹200. SmartBuy multipliers aren't modelled in v1; the agent should note them, not add them as rules.

name: ICICI Coral RuPay

reward.inrPerUnitNote: Typical catalogue/voucher value; varies by redemption.

reviewTips: 2 points per ₹100 (not fuel), 1 point per ₹100 on utilities and insurance. Same on UPI.

name: HSBC RuPay Cashback
reviewTips: Requested by a user. Reviews describe 10% on dining, food delivery and groceries under one combined monthly cap (about ₹400), and 1% on everything else including UPI. Check the cap amount and whether UPI spends earn the 10% too. If the page comes back thin, add HSBC's cashback T&C PDF linked from that page.
